newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Magician signs HK$150 million loan.
newsitem.headline: Magician signs HK$150 million loan.

text.p: Household product maker Magician Industries (Holdings) Ltd said on Thursday it had signed a HK$150 million term loan facility to finance expansion in China and overseas markets.
The facility has a tenor of three years and pays a margin of 150 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Citicorp International and ABN AMRO Bank were arrangers for the deal, Magician said.

"We are now building a new factory in Shatou, and plan to spend HK$12 million in setting up new offices and warehouses in various cities in China to cope with the strong demand for high quality products," chairman Tong Kong said.
